cards.card_text: Some time later, two officers offend their master, Pharaoh, the king of Egypt: his chief cupbearer and his chief baker.
cards.verse_text: Some time later, the king’s cupbearer and baker offended their master, the king of Egypt.
cards.snippet: Some time later, the king’s cupbearer and baker offended their master, the king of Egypt.

cards.verse_text: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream: “In my dream there was a vine before me, and on the vine were three branches.
cards.snippet: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream: “In my dream there was a vine before…

cards.card_text: What does Joseph say Pharaoh will do for the cupbearer within three days?
cards.verse_text: You will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.
cards.snippet: …cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.

cards.card_text: And right there, in front of all his officials, Pharaoh lifts up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
cards.verse_text: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he held a feast for all his officials, and in their presence he lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
cards.snippet: …and in their presence he lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.

cards.card_text: Joseph asked the chief cupbearer to remember him and mention him to Pharaoh.
cards.verse_text: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.
cards.snippet: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.

cards.card_text: The cupbearer tells Pharaoh, “Today I recall my failures.” Friend, that’s the guy answering your text two YEARS late.

cards.card_text: Then she sees it ALL: his wisdom, the palace he built, the food at his table, his servants and attendants, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presents at the house of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built, the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
